# Shruti 1.4.23 — clearer live audio activity
- Live Now separates apps playing output from apps recording input. A recorder such as NSM Screen Studio appears as recording without a misleading playback label. - Apps that used audio output in the past hour remain easy to find under Recent Audio, with the latest activity first. Each entry opens its saved control in My Order. - My Order and the playing-app arrangement keep their saved positions; recent activity does not silently rearrange the mix. - Audio activity is attributed to the app that owns the process. Chrome helper processes owned by another app are shown under that app.
